profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer, ngrok | early Twilio

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Staff software engineer supporting core ngrok products. Responsible for designing and implementing new products and features, maintaining existing products and fixing bugs, and mentoring other members of the team. Provide technical leadership and work closely with individuals and teams across the org.
positions.insights: Software Design, Go (Programming Language) and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Drove the architecture and delivery of Twilio’s internal operational data platform, unlocking organization-wide visibility into infrastructure insights, engineering team health, customer experience, and more. Built a scalable telemetry ingestion and query stack using Airflow, ECS, and Athena, enabling performant, SQL-based analysis across all AWS accounts. Authored standard practices around blast radius, SLOs, and performance testing to raise the bar for service resilience at scale.
positions.insights: Software Architecture, Data Build Tool (DBT) and +1 skill

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Led critical platform modernization efforts at Twilio, including rearchitecting the Studio storage layer to reduce costs and improve durability, and driving adoption of PHP 8.2 across key codebases to unblock product teams. Spearheaded regionalization and automation initiatives to meet global compliance needs. Delivered infrastructure tooling that scaled across thousands of microservices, achieving high internal adoption and accelerating CI/CD velocity. Created early platforms for collecting high-dimensioned, customer-specific data to support SLO calculations and understand incident impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led foundational engineering efforts on Twilio's Voice platform, launching customer-facing features like Call Progress Events and scaling backend infrastructure for reliability and performance. Built critical data pipelines and logging systems to support trust, observability, and compliance at scale. Drove platform-wide quality improvements through runtime safeguards, architecture refactors, and CI-enforced test coverage gates.
positions.insights: Apache Kafka, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Diagnosed and resolved SIP/RTP audio quality issues in Twilio's Voice platform, improving call reliability and customer experience. Built a comprehensive distributed logging system to accelerate debugging of server-client interactions, and published a Java helper library to Maven Central to streamline developer onboarding and integration.
positions.insights: VoIP protocols SIP, Real-Time Transport Protocol (RTP) and +2 skills

positions.title: Center for Information Technology Integration
positions.locationName: College of Engineering, Ann Arbor Campus
positions.description:
Researcher under Professor Peter Honeyman

http://citi.umich.edu/

honors.title: Top Twilio Volunteer award
honors.description:
Accumulated more volunteer hours via Twilio volunteer events than anyone else in the company from 2014-2016. 

These are some of the organizations I worked with:
McKinley Elementary (San Francisco Unified School District)
Glide SF
San Francisco and Marin Food Bank
SMASH (The Level Playing Field Institute)
The Presidio Trust (Golden Gate National Parks Conservancy)
DISH (Delivering Innovations in Supportive Housing)
honors.issuer: Issued by Twilio Volunteer Committee · Apr 2016
